subject.title: [Bug]: embedded prompt-cache continuity breaks across room events and native Responses

question: Should ambient room-event turns use one cache-stable safe owner-only tool inventory for every sender, with runtime authorization still blocking non-owner execution?
rationale: The candidate fixes the regression, but its sender-independent prompt inventory intentionally removes owner-only model affordances from owner ambient turns and therefore needs product ownership.

options.title: Accept Stable Safe Inventory
options.body: Use the non-owner-safe owner-only tool inventory for all ambient room events so prompt and tool prefixes remain stable while runtime authorization stays enforced.

options.title: Design Another Stable Policy
options.body: Choose a different sender-independent inventory or prompt contract and require equivalent cache-continuity and authorization proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Stable Safe Inventory
recommendation.body: Use the non-owner-safe owner-only tool inventory for all ambient room events so prompt and tool prefixes remain stable while runtime authorization stays enforced.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the stream-resolution, provider-identity, agent-tool, and Codex app-server decision surfaces involved.
